groundTruth.description: The Favorites view must not recommend opening the Favorites view itself.

hypotheses.title: Favoritos control text mismatch
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The top-level navigation includes both 'Favoritos' and 'Abrir meus favoritos'. The title also uses 'Favoritos'.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Consistent terminology should be used throughout the interface. Either all instances of the feature should use 'Favoritos', or all should use 'Abrir meus favoritos'.
hypotheses.oracle: The text displayed for the top-level navigation control and in the page title must match exactly, either both using 'Favoritos' or both using 'Abrir meus favoritos'.

hypotheses.title: Unclear value proposition of Favoritos
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The headings 'Seu coração ainda está leve' and 'Salve agora. Volte quando bater vontade.' are present under the Favoritos control but lack immediate clarity regarding their purpose.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: The text should clearly explain the benefit or function of using the Favoritos feature to the user, ideally with a call to action.
hypotheses.oracle: The headings associated with the 'Favoritos' section must directly and concisely describe how the feature benefits the user (e.g., 'Save your favorite items for later').

hypotheses.title: Inconsistent button labeling - Favoritos vs Início
hypotheses.observedEvidence: Both 'Favoritos' and 'Início' are present as buttons in the navigation bar, potentially confusing users about their function.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Buttons should have clear and distinct labels that accurately reflect their actions. If both lead to similar functionality, one should be removed or relabeled.
hypotheses.oracle: The 'Favoritos' button and the 'Início' button must either perform different actions or have clearly differentiated labels to avoid user confusion.

reviews.title: Favoritos control text mismatch
reviews.reason: The observed evidence directly matches the interface state. The expected behavior regarding consistent terminology is a reasonable interpretation of usability best practices.
reviews.suggestedOracle: The text displayed for the top-level navigation control and in the page title must match exactly, either both using 'Favoritos' or both using 'Abrir meus favoritos'.

reviews.title: Unclear value proposition of Favoritos
reviews.reason: The observed evidence accurately describes the headings present. The expected behavior regarding clarity is reasonable given the context of user experience.
reviews.suggestedOracle: The headings associated with the 'Favoritos' section must directly and concisely describe how the feature benefits the user (e.g., 'Save your favorite items for later').

reviews.title: Inconsistent button labeling - Favoritos vs Início
reviews.reason: The observed evidence confirms the presence of both buttons. The expected behavior regarding distinct labels is a reasonable usability concern.
reviews.suggestedOracle: The 'Favoritos' button and the 'Início' button must either perform different actions or have clearly differentiated labels to avoid user confusion.
